# Pi-Bifrost

> Query-aware model routing extension for the Pi coding agent.

Pi-Bifrost classifies prompts into configured tiers, selects an available model, and switches Pi's active model before sending. It is designed for predictable, inspectable routing with manual overrides and safe fallbacks.

## Links

- Landing page: https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/
- Source and documentation: https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-bifrost
- License: https://opensource.org/license/mit

## Install

```sh
pi install npm:pi-bifrost
```

Initialize inside Pi:

```text
/bifrost init
```

## Routing

1. Direct regex bindings can target an exact `provider/id`.
2. Cached classifications can be reused.
3. Prompts can be classified with regex rules or an optional LLM classifier.
4. A model is selected from the matching tier.
5. Pi activates the selected model before sending.

Metadata-based routing does not require an additional model call. LLM classification is optional and may add tokens and latency on cache misses.

## Selection strategies

Supported strategies include `cheapest`, `cheapest_input`, `cheapest_output`, `largest_context`, `random`, `first`, and `fastest`.

## Controls

- `/bifrost preview <prompt>` previews a route without sending.
- `/bifrost pin` pauses routing.
- `/bifrost unpin` resumes routing.
- `/bifrost classifier off` disables LLM classification.
- `/bifrost probe` checks model availability.
- `/bifrost reload` reloads configuration.

## Failure behavior

If classification fails, Pi-Bifrost tries configured fallbacks, then keeps Pi's current model if no route resolves. If no matching model can be activated, Pi keeps its current model.

## Privacy

The optional classifier receives the current prompt, tier names, and classifier instructions. It does not receive conversation history, prior messages, or tool output. Local cache and debug logging are optional.
